title: Assign Cookies
statement:
Assume you are an awesome parent and want to give your children some cookies. But, you should give each child at most one cookie.
Each child `i` has a greed factor `g[i]`, which is the minimum size of a cookie that the child will be content with; and each cookie `j` has a size `s[j]`. If `s[j] >= g[i]`, we can assign the cookie `j` to the child `i`, and the child `i` will be content.
Your goal is to maximize the number of your content children and output the maximum number.
inputFormat:
Line 1: N (number of children) and M (number of cookies).
Line 2: N space-separated integers for array `g`.
Line 3: M space-separated integers for array `s`. (Could be empty if M=0).
outputFormat: A single integer denoting the max content children.

examples.explanation: You have 3 children and 2 cookies. Only the child with greed 1 can be satisfied with the cookie of size 1.
You have 2 children and 3 cookies. Both children can be satisfied.
